title: Detailed bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under bell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <!-- bell body main shape -->
  <path d='M50 18 C30 18 22 34 22 52 L22 66 C22 72 18 76 14 79 L86 79 C82 76 78 72 78 66 L78 52 C78 34 70 18 50 18 Z' fill='#d4a012'/>
  <!-- bell body lighter highlight left -->
  <path d='M50 20 C33 20 26 35 26 52 L26 64 C26 69 23 73 20 76 L30 76 C33 72 35 68 35 64 L35 52 C35 37 40 24 50 22 Z' fill='#f0c840'/>
  <!-- bell body dark shade right -->
  <path d='M50 18 C70 18 78 34 78 52 L78 66 C78 72 82 76 86 79 L74 79 C77 76 78 72 78 66 L78 52 C78 34 70 18 50 18 Z' fill='#b8860b'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <path d='M14 79 L86 79 C86 82 82 84 78 84 L22 84 C18 84 14 82 14 79 Z' fill='#c4920e'/>
  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <path d='M20 80 L80 80 L78 82 L22 82 Z' fill='#f0c840'/>
  <!-- top loop / handle -->
  <path d='M46 18 C46 12 50 8 50 8 C50 8 54 12 54 18' fill='none' stroke='#d4a012' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#c4920e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='2.2' fill='#1a3a5c'/>
  <!-- decorative band across middle -->
  <rect x='24' y='50' width='52' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c4920e'/>
  <rect x='25' y='50.5' width='50' height='2' rx='1' fill='#f0c840'/>
  <!-- clapper visible below rim -->
  <line x1='50' y1='84' x2='50' y2='91' stroke='#b8860b' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='92.5' r='3.2' fill='#b8860b'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='91.5' r='1.2' fill='#f0c840'/>
  <!-- shine spot on body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- small decorative dots -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2' fill='#f0c840'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#f0c840'/>
</svg>
